tasks.evidence: compose.dev.yaml and compose.prod.yaml config --quiet exited 0. pytest.ini uses PostgreSQL. tests/test_health.py passed. Dev stack health returned {"status": "ok"}.
accounts.User is the auth model, created before other app migrations. Cross-tenant 404 and check-in staff 403 passed. DEBUG=False login redirects to MFA enrollment.
Idempotency replay and payload mismatch passed. AuditLog has an append-only database trigger in audit/migrations/0002_append_only.py.
Archive/unarchive, nonexistent DST time, SVG rejection, and PNG re-encode passed. Browser login opened the event list and Spring dinner.
A01 capacity test passed. Browser Add table created T3 in open space after the default coordinate overlap was fixed.
Stable ticket and protected quantity tests passed. Booking list showed Ada and guest@example.test.
Import tests covered duplicates, attendee_names, stale roster 409, and absence without deletion. Import page rendered.
Concurrency tests A06-A09 passed, including expired-hold reuse without beat.
Stale geometry conflict passed. Browser assign and unassign forms seated and cleared T3 seat 1.
SVG editor rendered table and seat buttons with text status. Keyboard Add table, Assign, and Unassign worked. Playwright binaries were not installed.
Publication snapshot remained stable after a later geometry edit. Publications page rendered with no snapshot until publish.
Check-in idempotency and cancelled-ticket tests passed. Browser search found Ada and reported Checked in.
Outbox tests passed. MailDev stored one Spring dinner message to guest@example.test.
Local webhook signature, replay, bounce, and suppression tests passed. No real SendGrid staging send or webhook was attempted.
WeasyPrint PDF test passed and the browser export page showed room_plan ready. Visual clipping was not measured.
Clearing the Redis cache left the pending outbox row, and dispatch then submitted it. Expired holds are released inside assignment.

compose.prod.yaml splits event_tables, event_tables_migrate, and event_tables_app. test_runtime_database_role_cannot_create_tables passed. Image digests are pinned. requirements.lock records the development image freeze. The app image was not pushed to a registry.

deploy/backup.sh and deploy/restore.sh exist. Isolated restore rehearsal finished in 5.75 seconds and the temporary database was dropped. Production-sized RPO/RTO and private-file restore were not measured. Log redaction test passed.
See docs/acceptance-results.md. A02, A14, A16, A18, and A20 are partial. Performance targets were not measured.
